name: Boys & Girls Club of Mount Vernon Summer Program
operator_name: Boys & Girls Club of Mount Vernon
description_short: Seven week summer program at the Boys & Girls Club of Mount Vernon for ages 5 to 13, with STEM and arts activities, life skills, sports including basketball clinics, weekly swimming, dance and tennis, and weekly field trips. Free breakfast and lunch are served.
notes: Program fee $130 a week per child plus a $100 registration fee (includes one T shirt, required on trips); each additional child $100 a week. Weekdays 8 am to 4 pm; families needing care beyond those hours should call the Club. Registration was closed when checked.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Programs page: 7 weeks, July 6 to August 21, 2026, ages 5 to 13, weekdays 8 to 4, $130 a week plus $100 registration. The page still mentions a July 3, 2025 early payment date, left over from 2025.
Researched by Claude from this page. Contact page: 350 South Sixth Avenue, Mount Vernon, NY 10550; 914-668-9580; info@bgcmvny.org. The summer page names no other site, so the Club's address is used.
